Articles

Questionnaire templates

10 example questionnaires, each with an analysis plan to adapt and screenshots of the study in SurveyStudio, grouped by field.

Questionnaire templates

10 example questionnaires, each with an analysis plan to adapt, in psychology, education, business, events and tourism, and research methods.

Course evaluation survey

A course evaluation in which students rate each part of a course on 1 grid, compared between students who took it in person and online. surveyframe gives you the questionnaire, the analysis plan and a report for the teaching team.

Customer satisfaction survey

A customer study of return intention: whether customers who use a service more come back, and how that use relates to their satisfaction and the offer they prefer. surveyframe gives you the questionnaire, a plan with logistic regressions declared in advance, and the report.

Employee engagement survey

An engagement survey of 8 items written to measure 2 dimensions, how work is organised and the content of the work, with a check that employees’ answers support 2 scores. surveyframe gives you the questionnaire, the analysis plan and the report.

Likert scale questionnaire

A short questionnaire that measures 1 idea with a 4-item Likert scale, including a reverse-worded item, and checks that the scale holds together before its score is used. surveyframe gives you the questionnaire, a pre-analysis plan to submit with your proposal, and an APA 7 report.

Measurement model questionnaire (CFA and SEM)

A study exploring a proposed relationship between content quality, satisfaction and the intention to return. Specify the measurement and structural model, then generate syntax for lavaan or seminr. surveyframe gives you the questionnaire, the model syntax and the report.

Open-ended feedback survey

A feedback survey of what worked and what to change, analysed as text: frequent words and phrases, words in context, sentiment and topics. surveyframe gives you the questionnaire, the analysis plan and the report.

Pilot survey with a small sample

A pilot with 18 participants that answers the main study’s questions with methods suited to a small sample: a rank-based comparison, an exact test and a penalised logistic regression. surveyframe gives you the questionnaire, the pre-analysis plan and the report.

Preparing a survey study for preregistration

A survey study whose instrument and analysis plan are saved with a hash before data collection, with any later change recorded as a disclosed amendment. surveyframe writes a pre-analysis plan for you to complete and register on OSF or Zenodo, and a report that names the instrument it analysed.

Supplier and venue selection (decision making)

Compare candidate suppliers or venues using the criteria your committee values. Record the criteria and the judgements, then review the rankings your selected methods produce. surveyframe gives you the questionnaire, the analysis plan and the report.

Training evaluation before and after

Compare the same participants’ confidence, and their willingness to recommend a workshop, before and after the training. Plan the paired comparisons before collecting responses. surveyframe gives you the questionnaire, the plan and the report.

Documentation

How to set up each question type and each analysis method, with screenshots of SurveyStudio.

Documentation: how to set up surveyframe

How to set up each question type and analysis in surveyframe, step by step, with annotated SurveyStudio screenshots.

Test an association between categories

These methods test whether 2 categorical answers go together.

Measure how answers go together

These methods measure how strongly 2 numeric or ordered answers move together, and whether that holds with a third held constant.

Add a criteria weighting question

Add a question, choose Criteria weight, and list the criteria to divide 100 points across.

Add a date question

Add a question and choose Date. The respondent picks it from a calendar.

Choose between options

These methods weigh each criterion and rank the options.

Describe the answers and their quality

These methods describe who answered what, how complete the answers are, and which responses the quality checks flag.

Check structure and write model syntax

These methods check whether items measure the factors assumed, write the lavaan or seminr syntax for a declared model, and estimate mediation and moderation.

Add a grid of rating questions

Add a question, choose Matrix, list the rows, and pick the scale every row is rated on.

Compare groups

These methods test whether an outcome differs between 2 or more groups of respondents.

Add a Likert question to a scale

Add a question, choose Likert, and choose the choice set that holds its answer options, such as Strongly disagree to Strongly agree.

Add an open-ended question

Add a question and choose Long text for a paragraph.

Add a choose-any question

Add a question, choose Multiple choice, and give the options the respondent may tick.

Add a number question

Add a question, choose Numeric, and set the range the answer may take.

Add pairwise comparisons

Choose the task first. To find which criteria matter most (AHP, ANP), use Saaty’s importance scale. To find how criteria influence each other (DEMATEL), use the influence scale. Then add a question, choose Pairwise comparison and list the criteria.

Add a ranking question

Add a question, choose Ranking, and give the options to put in order.

Predict an outcome

These methods estimate how much predictors explain a numeric outcome, or how they change the odds of a yes, an ordered rating or a choice.

Compare the same people over time

These methods test whether answers change between 2 or more measurements of the same respondents.

Score a scale and check its reliability

These methods give a scale’s score and test whether its items hold together.

Add a short text question

Add a question and choose Short text for a word or a line.

Add a single-choice question

Add a question, choose Single choice, and give the options the respondent picks 1 from.

Add a slider rating

Add a question, choose Slider, and set its range and step.

Add a star rating

Add a question and choose Rating for a row of stars.

Analyse open answers

These methods find the words, phrases, contexts, tones and topics in open answers.
